physical_scope: Conditional cold dilute adsorption on fixed-area neutral sheets. One-dimensional arclength confinement in a prescribed stationary flow with trial constant specific drag. Neither the sustainable supply of energy nor the freely moving mouth force was measured.
units: All transfer energies are specific energies using the inherited half represented mass per sheet convention. Drag/mass in inverse model time.

local_scientific_reviews.scope: Direct independent surface energy minimization, area-average force and shuffle check, common-reference limitations.
local_scientific_reviews.verdict: Scoped clear for the cold, fixed-area excess work along the locally stable surface-bound branch of the two specified contact laws, and for their distinct fixed-height, area-averaged normal holding forces on a clamped flat host at fixed surface density.

local_scientific_reviews.scope: Adsorption branch, normal probe, phase-work requirements and necessary drag bounds.
local_scientific_reviews.verdict: Scoped clear for the fixed-area, locally stable adsorption branch and the necessary constant-drag work bounds.

local_scientific_reviews.scope: Three-point energy inequalities, refinement, first-passage classifications and energy margins in the trial one-dimensional guide.
local_scientific_reviews.verdict: Scoped clear for cold first passage under the prescribed one-dimensional force law.

local_scientific_reviews.scope: Physical work and slip heat, energy debit, and review of the report against source. Rounded guaranteed bounds inward.
local_scientific_reviews.verdict: Scoped clear for the crossing-work calculation and the slip-heat bound under the prescribed one-dimensional reciprocal drag law.
